hint.ACCESS_DENIED: Windows denied the node access to its IPC pipe or data files, usually because a geth.exe from an earlier session is still running. Close the geth.exe process in Task Manager (Details tab) or restart the computer, then click Retry.
hint.PORT_RESERVED: Windows has reserved port {{port}}, which the node needs (Hyper-V and WSL reserve whole port ranges). Change the Listen port in Settings → Network, or restart CointMU so it picks other ports, then click Retry.
hint.PORT_IN_USE: Another program is using the node's network port. Close it or change the Listen port in Settings → Network, then retry.
hint.DB_LOCKED: The node database is in use by another process, such as another CointMU or geth instance. Close it, then retry.
hint.failed: Your wallet keystore was not touched. Retry, or restart the app; if it keeps failing, report an issue with the logs.
